verdict.rationale: Scribe is an API-first service that runs entirely headlessly. It documents a synchronous REST transcription endpoint, batch jobs with pollable status and lifecycle endpoints, signed webhooks on job completion, and API credentials with expiry, IP allowlist and scopes, which is enough for unattended pipelines. Missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific integration guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Batch mode documents POST /aiservices/scribe/jobs plus get-status, list-jobs, cancel-job, list-files, and get-file endpoints.
A batch submission can register notifications.webhook_url and a secret to receive an outbound POST when the job finishes.
Expires after. Choose an expiration option... IP allowlist. Enter any IP addresses that you want to allow... Permissions. Choose scopes for APIs.
Fast mode provides synchronous transcription for individual audio files.
